prompt: Some people think university education should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is growing debate over whether university education should be provided free of charge to all students. While it is understandable why some people support this view, I largely agree with it, as removing tuition fees could widen access to higher education and promote greater social mobility.

The most compelling reason for this position is that free university education could widen access to higher education. This is particularly important because tuition fees can place a substantial financial burden on students from low-income families. In practical terms, removing these costs would allow academically capable students to pursue a degree without having to rely heavily on their families or take on significant debt. A clear example of this can be seen in students from disadvantaged backgrounds who may otherwise be forced to enter the workforce immediately after school. As a result, a wider range of people could obtain professional qualifications, making it considerably more likely that higher education would contribute to greater social mobility.

A further point worth considering is that free access to university could produce broader economic benefits. The underlying reason is that a larger proportion of the population would have an opportunity to acquire specialised knowledge and professional skills. This can have far-reaching consequences, particularly for countries that depend on a highly educated workforce to remain economically competitive. For instance, if talented students are not prevented from attending university by financial constraints, more of them may eventually enter fields such as medicine, engineering and finance. Taken together, these effects suggest that publicly funded higher education can benefit society beyond the individual student, which further strengthens the case for making university education more accessible.

In conclusion, although providing free university education would place a considerable financial burden on governments, I believe that it should be made accessible to all students. This is primarily because it can remove financial barriers to higher education, while also contributing to a more skilled and productive workforce.
